sentences.text:
Date : --03.12.2025 Heard Mr. J.D. Baruah, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. P.R. Mahanta,
learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department for the respondent nos. 2,
3 & 4; Mr. P.K. Medhi, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent no. 5; and Mr. R.K. Talukdar, learned Standing Counsel, NHAI for the respondent nos. 6 & 7.
2.

The petitioner has approached this Court with a grievance that after the matter of compensation against land acquisition was remanded back to the Arbitrator to start a de novo proceeding by an Order dated 20.10.2022 passed in Arbitration Appeal no. 16/2015 by this Court, the Arbitrator appointed under Section 3G[5] of the National Highways Act, 1956 has not proceeded further with the matter de novo in respect of Case no. ESTT.10/2010-2011 Page No.# 4/5 [Shri Joymonta Thomson vs. The Secretary, Revenue, Dima Hasao Autonomous Council, Haflong and others].
3.

sentences.text:
On the previous date, 19.11.2025, Ms. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department was asked to obtain instructions as regards the present status of Page No.# 1/5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164443955/
3 Arbitration Case no. ESTT.10/2010-2011.
4.
Ms. Mahanta has placed a Communication no. LA&A.eCF/729646/45 dated 02.12.2025 from the Secretary to the Government of Assam, Revenue & Disaster Management Department, addressed to her.

As per the instruction so placed, it is noticed that the Arbitration Case no. ESTT.10/2010-2011 is in the process of being traced out subsequent to transfer of the physical records of all the arbitration cases to the Revenue & Disaster Management Department vide notification dated 21.02.2024.
All the case records are being processed for conversion into e-filing system after necessary scanning.
The Department has, thus, sought further four weeks' time to provide an up-to-date status in respect of the Arbitration Case no. ESTT.10/2010-2011.

5. Let notice be issued, returnable on 07.01.2026.
6.

As Ms. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department has appeared and accepted notices for the respondent nos. 2, 3 & 4; Mr. Medhi, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam has appeared and accepted notice for the respondent no. 5; and Mr.
Talukdar, learned Standing Counsel, NHAI has appeared and accepted notices for the respondent nos. 6 & 7, formal notices need not be issued to the said respondents.

Mr. Baruah, learned counsel for the petitioners shall furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petition along with the annexures, to Ms. Mahanta, Mr. Medhi and Mr. Talukdar, within 2 [two] working days from today.

7. The learned counsel for the petitioner shall furnish a copy of the writ petition along with annexures to the learned Standing Counsel, General Administration Department for service of notice upon the respondent no. 1, within 2 [two] working days from today.
8.
The name of the learned Standing Counsel, General Administration Department for the Page No.# 5/5 respondent no. 1 is to be reflected in the respondent's side in the Cause-List.
9. On the next date, Ms. Mahanta shall furnish instructions as regards up-to-date status of Arbitration Case no. ESTT.10/2010-2011.
10. The Communication dated 02.12.2025 placed by Ms. Mahanta is kept with the case record.
